title: Cutout Image List Tool for DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys and More

author.name: yymao
author.field: Observational astronomy (galaxy target selection and visual inspection)

provenance.origin: github.com/yymao/decals-image-list-tool at dc1349c6a832, github (github: topic:webapp topic:astronomy archived:false (page 1))

notes: Found in a public repository and run by a computer-use agent (batch public-1). Paste a table of sky positions (RA/Dec), see a grid of image cutouts from a chosen survey (Legacy Surveys, SDSS, DSS, WISE, GALEX, HSC, DES and others), click cutouts to flag them, and write the flags back into the table as a 'marked' column. Data used in the run: example. tree.json is the workflow the agent did and a second agent replayed; run.json says how.
